facts.text: The resort sits within a 160-acre sanctuary on the island of Vanua Levu in Fiji.

facts.text: Vanua Levu is Fiji's second largest island.

facts.text: The resort is in Savusavu, a short flight from Nadi International Airport to Savusavu or Labasa airports.

facts.text: Complimentary ground transfers are provided from Savusavu Airport or Labasa Airport.
